Śaṅkarācārya
son of Śivaguru, disciple of Govindācārya who was disciple of Gauḍapāda. He was guru of Pādapadma, Hall p. 88.
See T. R. Chintamani, The date of Śrī Śaṅkarācārya an. some of his predecessors (summary) AIOC. V. 119; also see B. V. Kamesvara, The probable date of Śaṅkara, AIOC. IV. Vol. I. 38-40; for a note on the date see J. of Myth. Soc. XX. p. 313.
The date of the exponent of the adv. system of philosophy is fixed a. 1st Century C.E. See for discussion on his date, see Poona Ori. XIX. p.. 35-39.
